images.title: Reflection 01 - Arrival - Moon 1 Day 1
images.scene: The traveller waits inside the fragile shelter as the unlit valley darkens, with a stone edge, unused fuel and the shells of his only meal.
images.detail: CUTOFF: end of arrival Day 1 near NEW MOON. Broad quiet composition looking towards the southeast-facing mouth of the VERY LOW original debris shelter, about one metre high at most beneath fallen limb. Shelter and seated man occupy LEFT THIRD, a large dark valley fills the right/two thirds. View towards northwest from outside shelter, with the unseen river below and behind camera, not relocated into backdrop. He curls or sits just inside deep dry leaf litter at the opening, knees drawn up, visibly exhausted, face turned out towards unseen valley; watchful lonely expression, ordinary proportions, not crying or heroic. Rough bark waist panels ONLY, bare shoulders/torso, no skin products or fur pad. A single small unhafted flake, rounded hammer cobble and a few EMPTY hazelnut shells on bare stone outside door. Small modest unused dry fuel sticks, NO ignition kit. Indigo/slate darkness with last faint dusk reflected in face and leaves, cold muted warm-paper shadows, deep atmospheric empty space; enough light to see the expression without any invented lamp. No visible lunar disk, crescent, moonlight, fire, ember, ash, smoke, pot, vessel, spear, bag, animal skin, whorl, cord coil or working furniture. Emotional argument: all the knowledge of civilisation has left him with a fragile bed and one useful edge; no physical futuristic object.

images.title: Reflection 02 - Full Moon - Moon 1 Day 15
images.scene: Moonlight reveals the modest camp while the traveller watches the untouched, untested clay cup cool on the separate firing bed.

Lowered shoulders, alert quiet anxiety, discouraged yet purposeful.
CLOTHING: anatomical RIGHT near shoulder/upper arm completely BARE; very narrow fox panel on FAR LEFT shoulder mostly behind neck/back, no coat/vest. Opaque overlapping bark waist panels fully cover intimate areas with small rabbit pelvic pad; bare feet; nonsexual.

Old rejected clay pinch cup empty/dry with fine wall crack but intact rim and no missing chunks. No abundance.
